extension.summary: Pick from a list of websites, launch fullscreen in Chrome, and control the mouse with the Kodi remote
extension.description: Shows a menu of configured websites, then launches your choice fullscreen in Chrome (kiosk mode) and lets you move the real Windows mouse cursor and click using Kodi's remote directional buttons. Configure up to 5 sites in addon settings. Windows only.
